original_test_intent: Across each approved socket/downstream port, inject a completion timeout classified non-fatal and prove eDPC contains it by asserting CTE/DPCTS and taking the link down while halted, then automatically clears status and retrains the same endpoint to its original speed/width after release.
original_method: The FAE maps each physical endpoint/root port to version-correct register paths, records original link state, proves CT is unmasked/non-fatal and DPC enabled under the selected ownership model, performs one CTO injection, captures halted transition registers, releases once and verifies automatic clear, retraining, endpoint health and OS reporting without manual register clear.
manual_activity: The FAE approves register paths and ownership, enables BIOS settings, halts/injects/releases once and owns recovery. The agent may validate before/during/after register and link evidence but must not clear status manually.
required_inputs: Socket 1~N to endpoint/root-port BDF, Cscript port and register-path coverage
ITP/CScripts build/hash and exact completion-timeout selector behind `errType='uce'`
EMCA/OS Native AER/DPC ownership, CT severity/mask and DPC-enable definitions
Per-link original speed/width and expected CTE/DPCTS/DLLA/clear/retrain oracle
Endpoint quiesce, abort, OOB recovery and BIOS restoration plan
safety_requirements: Use current map/register schema; no reuse of socket1 port2 example
Prove CT non-fatal, unmasked and DPC enabled before one injection
Abort on wrong bit/path, fatal escalation, host reset, link not retraining or endpoint loss
Do not manually clear registers that the test requires to auto-clear; never retry automatically
agent_execution_scope: Validate mapping and immutable register/link captures; collect Windows, BMC/UEFI and health evidence
Do not change ownership/BIOS, halt/inject/release, clear registers, reset/retry or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve per-socket path/register coverage and CTO semantics
Define AER/DPC ownership and exact transition bits
Set original-link restoration and endpoint-health acceptance

command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: CT non-fatal/DPC transition, no manual clear, one go/retrain sequence and 60/15-minute estimates are preserved; Gen1/Gen4 values remain examples until mapped.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture signed pre/during/post register snapshots and a link-state timeline for each mapped root port, prove exact CTE/DPCTS assertion while halted and automatic clearing/retrain to the captured original speed/width after one release, then verify endpoint and OS health.

modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong path or severity can down an unrelated device, trigger a fatal reset or leave the endpoint unavailable.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Socket 1~N is represented only by hardcoded socket1/port2 registers; `errType='uce'` is not shown to select CTO; Gen1 down/Gen4 restored are example-specific; OS Native AER/EMCA/DPC ownership is not reconciled; and optional Criteria do not encode the detailed mandatory register transition.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The eDPC completion-timeout containment sequence is unusually detailed and understandable. A versioned path/register map, CTO selector and ownership/recovery plan can resolve execution.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 34 Wistron-System RAS-00754-V002: approve Socket 1~N endpoint/root-port/BDF/Cscript/register-path coverage replacing the socket1/port2 example, ITP/CScripts version/hash and proof that `uce` selects completion timeout, EMCA/OS Native AER/DPC ownership and CT mask/severity, per-link original speed/width, exact CTE/DPCTS/DLLA/auto-clear/retrain oracle, recovery and restoration.

review_improvement: Makes the source's register-level eDPC sequence authoritative while preventing one example port and Gen4 speed from being copied across all sockets.
independent_technical_reasoning: The defining evidence is a state machine: clean registers and original link, CTE/DPCTS with containment while halted, then automatic clearing and retraining after `go`. A generic `uce` command or post-event log does not prove that chain. Because the source hardcodes one register hierarchy and example speeds while claiming Socket 1~N, the FAE must provide a per-target translation and package-specific CTO selector. Those inputs are feasible, so RPUC is appropriate and the mismatch is a source conflict rather than an irreducible block.
